zh: 修复长对话列表中较早的置顶会话被新会话挤出首屏分页的问题：置顶会话现按自定义排序始终优先返回，并支持按改名别名检索。
修复侧栏「查看已归档对话」与手机端归档列表遗漏问题：切换归档视图时直接向后端按 archived=1/0 分页拉取，同时将首屏分页扩至 80 条以完整保留空间对话；手机端 `/api/ai/sessions-archive` 同步兼容通过列表归档的会话。
en: Fixed older pinned conversations dropping off page 1 when newer sessions exceed the page limit: active pinned chats now sort first by pin_order and match custom alias titles during search.

Fixed Web and Mobile archived views missing preference-archived conversations: switching to Archived now queries the backend directly (archived=1/0), increased initial sidebar page size to 80 to retain workspace chats, and included preference-archived sessions in `/api/ai/sessions-archive`.
